items.title_zh: Meta 暂停 Muse 对话分享功能：研究者发现 AI 聊天记录可在网上公开访问
items.title_en: Meta pauses Muse sharing after researchers find AI chats on the web
items.summary_zh: Meta 表示已暂停 Muse 的一项功能——该功能允许用户把与这款 AI 助手的对话分享出去。此前有研究者在公开网络上发现了这些分享页面的链接。据 Ars Technica 报道，安全公司 Claroc 在本周发布的报告中称，他们通过公开的 DNS 记录找到了超过 6800 条 Muse 链接。Muse 发言人 Tracy Clayton 在给 The Verge 的邮件声明中解释，用户本可以分享特定的 Muse 内容（artifacts），这会生成一个“持有链接者即可访问”的页面；但在审查这份报告期间，Meta 已暂停该功能。此事再度引发对 AI 对话分享机制是否会意外泄露用户内容的担忧。
items.summary_en: Meta says it paused a Muse feature that lets you share conversations with the AI assistant after researchers found the URLs publicly available on the web, as reported by Ars Technica . In a report published this week , researchers at the security firm Claroc say they found more than 6,800 Muse links through public DNS records. "People have the ability to share specific Muse artifacts, which creates a page that can be accessed by those with the link," Muse spokesperson Tracy Clayton says in an emailed statement to The Verge . "However, we've paused this functionality while we review this report…
items.why_zh: AI 助手的“分享”链接若可被公开检索，可能让用户以为私密的对话内容暴露在互联网上。
items.why_en: If shareable AI chat links can be discovered publicly, users' supposedly private conversations may end up exposed on the open web.

items.title_zh: Tripo AI 宣布世界模型重大进展：实时生成式渲染支持交互体验
items.title_en: Tripo AI Announces Major Milestone in Its World Model With Real-Time Generative Rendering for Interactive Experiences
items.summary_zh: Tripo AI 通过新闻稿宣布，其世界模型（World Model）取得重大里程碑，实现了面向交互体验的实时生成式渲染能力。该能力意味着模型可在交互过程中即时生成渲染画面，而非依赖预先制作的内容，从而支撑更具实时性的互动场景。目前官方披露的信息集中于技术进展本身，尚未公布具体的产品形态、上线时间或合作方细节。若该能力落地，将有望用于游戏、虚拟现实与实时三维内容创作等对时延敏感的场景。
items.summary_en: Tripo AI Announces Major Milestone in Its World Model With Real-Time Generative Rendering for Interactive Experiences PR Newswire
items.why_zh: 实时生成式渲染是世界模型走向可交互应用的关键一步，可能改变游戏与三维内容的生产方式。
items.why_en: Real-time generative rendering is a key step toward interactive world models and could reshape how games and 3D content are produced.

items.title_zh: 埃里克·施密特持有的1% Anthropic股份在IPO时或价值数百亿美元
items.title_en: Eric Schmidt’s 1% Anthropic stake could be worth tens of billions at IPO
items.summary_zh: 据《洛杉矶时报》报道，前谷歌CEO埃里克·施密特持有AI公司Anthropic约1%的股份。随着Anthropic未来可能启动IPO，这部分持股的价值可能达到数百亿美元。报道未披露Anthropic的具体估值、IPO时间表或施密特的持股成本。该消息凸显AI热潮中早期投资者的潜在巨额回报，也让外界更加关注Anthropic的上市前景与估值水平。
items.summary_en: Eric Schmidt’s 1% Anthropic stake could be worth tens of billions at IPO Los Angeles Times
items.why_zh: 若Anthropic上市，施密特的持股将成为AI投资回报的标志性案例，并影响市场对AI估值的预期。
items.why_en: If Anthropic goes public, Schmidt’s stake could become a landmark case for AI investment returns and shape market expectations for AI valuations.

items.title_zh: 正面硬刚DeepSeek！MiniMax M3.1 Flash发布，输出卷到200+TPS，价格砍到1/2
items.title_en: MiniMax releases M3.1 Flash, pushing 200+ TPS output at half the price to take on DeepSeek
items.summary_zh: 正面硬刚DeepSeek！MiniMax M3.1 Flash发布，输出卷到200+TPS，价格砍到1/2 新浪网
items.summary_en: MiniMax has released the M3.1 Flash model, emphasizing output throughput of more than 200 TPS and a price cut to roughly half, positioning it as a direct competitor to DeepSeek. The report frames the launch around speed and cost rather than detailed benchmark comparisons.
items.why_zh: 国产模型在速度与价格上的持续对垒，直接压低开发者使用大模型推理的成本门槛。
items.why_en: Head-to-head competition on speed and price among Chinese model makers directly lowers the cost barrier for developers running inference.

items.title_zh: Electric Plant Company 结束隐身模式：融资 1120 万美元，推出植物基础模型 Bombadil
items.title_en: Electric Plant Company Launches From Stealth With $11.2M in Funding and a Foundation AI Model for Plants, Bombadil
items.summary_zh: Electric Plant Company 正式结束隐身模式，宣布获得 1120 万美元融资，并推出一款面向植物的基础 AI 模型，命名为 Bombadil。该公司的方向是把基础模型能力延伸到植物领域，试图用 AI 理解和建模植物相关的数据与规律。这一消息由 Morningstar 报道。此类“垂直领域基础模型”是当前 AI 创业的热门路径之一：在通用大模型之上，针对特定行业的数据与任务做专门化训练。
items.summary_en: Electric Plant Company Launches From Stealth With $11.2M in Funding and a Foundation AI Model for Plants, Bombadil Morningstar
items.why_zh: 植物领域的专用基础模型，代表 AI 正从通用能力向垂直科学领域纵深扩展。
items.why_en: A plant-focused foundation model illustrates how AI is moving from general capabilities into specialized scientific domains.

items.title_zh: Celigo 推出 MCP 工具管理，面向企业 AI 助手与智能体接入
items.title_en: Celigo launches MCP tool management for enterprise AI assistants and agent access
items.summary_zh: 集成平台厂商 Celigo 宣布推出面向 MCP（Model Context Protocol）的工具管理能力，用于企业管理 AI 助手与智能体对各类工具的访问。该功能的目标是让企业在把 AI 助手和 Agent 接入内部系统与业务工具时，能够统一管理权限与调用范围。随着企业级 Agent 部署增多，如何安全、可控地暴露工具接口成为关键问题，Celigo 此举正是切入这一治理环节。目前公开信息未披露具体定价与客户案例。
items.summary_en: Celigo launches MCP tool management for enterprise AI assistants and agent access SiliconANGLE
items.why_zh: 随着企业大规模部署 AI 智能体，工具访问的权限与治理正成为落地成败的关键环节。
items.why_en: As enterprises deploy agents at scale, governing tool access and permissions becomes critical to adoption.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek一张卡每小时收入38美元 开源核心技术引发热议
items.title_en: DeepSeek Reportedly Earns $38 Per Card Per Hour as Open-Sourced Core Tech Sparks Debate
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek一张卡每小时收入38美元 开源核心技术引发热议 中华网
items.summary_en: Reports say DeepSeek generates roughly $38 in revenue per card per hour, while its decision to open-source core technology has triggered wide industry debate over efficiency, moats and business sustainability.
items.why_zh: 单卡收入数据与开源策略并置，折射出大模型厂商在成本效率与生态开放之间的权衡。
items.why_en: The per-card revenue figure alongside open-sourcing highlights the trade-off between cost efficiency and ecosystem openness for model makers.

items.title_zh: 蒙大拿大学推出该州首个“以人为本”AI职业证书
items.title_en: UM Launches Montana’s First ‘Human-Centered’ AI Career Certificate
items.summary_zh: 蒙大拿大学推出蒙大拿州首个“以人为本”的AI职业证书项目，面向希望提升AI职业技能的学习者。该项目强调以人为中心的AI应用，而非单纯技术训练。报道未披露课程安排、费用、开课时间等细节。此举反映高校正加快推出AI技能认证，以回应职场对AI人才的需求。
items.summary_en: UM Launches Montana’s First ‘Human-Centered’ AI Career Certificate University of Montana
items.why_zh: 高校推出AI职业证书，反映AI技能培训正进入正规教育体系，回应就业市场变化。
items.why_en: The university certificate shows AI skills training entering formal education and responding to labor-market demand.

items.title_zh: 单卡月收入或超18万元，DeepSeek开源核心推理框架
items.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources Core Inference Framework; Single-Card Monthly Revenue Could Top 180,000 Yuan
items.summary_zh: 单卡月收入或超18万元，DeepSeek开源核心推理框架 同花顺
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced its core inference framework, with reports suggesting a single card could generate more than 180,000 yuan in monthly revenue. The move could lower barriers to AI inference deployment and points to inference services as a key commercialization path.
items.why_zh: 核心推理框架开源可能降低AI部署成本，并改变推理服务的商业竞争格局。
items.why_en: Open-sourcing a core inference framework could lower AI deployment costs and reshape competition in inference services.

items.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources Inference Framework
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek开源推理框架 新京报
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced its inference framework, according to Beijing News. Developers can now use and study the framework for model inference deployment, potentially reducing reliance on closed-source options. Technical details and licensing terms were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 推理框架开源有助于扩大DeepSeek开发者生态，并降低模型部署门槛。
items.why_en: Open-sourcing the inference framework can expand DeepSeek’s developer ecosystem and lower model deployment barriers.

items.title_zh: 消息称华为乾崑准备推出新智驾方案：比 ADS Pro 更便宜，但又高于 SE 版本
items.title_en: Huawei Qiankun to Launch New Smart-Driving Package Priced Between ADS Pro and SE
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，据博主 @新出行贺磊 分享， 华为乾崑最近的智驾用户开通费的问题开始遇到阻力 ，他们也在积极地调研中。 该博主透露，华为乾崑准备推出一款新的智驾方案， 价格比 ADS Pro 更便宜，但又高于 SE 版本 。博主还在评论区补充， 称新方案对比的是 SE，应该能力是提升的 。 据IT之家了解，华为乾崑智驾共有 Ultra / Max / Pro / SE 四个档位： 第 1 档是 ADS SE 基础版：满足基本的主动安全、泊车辅助、高速 NCA 及城区 LCC+ 功能，经济型车型首选。 第 2 档是 ADS Pro 增强版：搭载舱内激光视觉传感器，主动安全能力与城区 LCC+ 功能进一步增强，标准型车型首选。 第 3 档是 ADS Max 超阶版：搭载高性能超远距激光，可选配分布式毫米波雷达及高精度固态激光雷达，支持全维主动安全、高速 NCA、城区 NCA 及车位到车位与泊车代驾等高级功能，豪华型车型首选。 第 4 档是 ADS Ultra 旗舰版：具备高速 L3 能力，高端旗舰车型首选。 在今年 4 月 23 日晚，华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5 正式发布 。算法层面，华为发布了面向自动驾驶的 AI 智能体 WEWA 2.0 架构。该架构在云端引入 Multi-Agent 博弈技术与在线强化学习机制；在车端应用了安全风险场技术进行实时安全评估，并通过 D…
items.summary_en: Huawei’s Qiankun is reportedly preparing a new smart-driving package priced below ADS Pro but above the SE version, with improved capability over SE, according to a blogger. The move comes as the company faces resistance over user activation fees.
items.why_zh: 新增价格档位有助于华为覆盖更多车型与用户，并缓解智驾功能收费阻力。
items.why_en: A new price tier could help Huawei cover more vehicle segments and ease resistance to smart-driving feature fees.

items.title_zh: 前OpenAI高管创立AI制造初创公司Arda，规模达15亿美元
items.title_en: Ex-OpenAI Exec Launches $1.5B AI Manufacturing Startup Arda
items.summary_zh: 据The Tech Buzz报道，一名前OpenAI高管创立了专注于AI制造的初创公司Arda，该公司以15亿美元规模亮相。报道未在摘要中说明该数字是融资额还是估值，也未披露具体产品、投资方和落地计划。该消息显示，AI正加速向制造业等实体产业渗透。
items.summary_en: Ex-OpenAI Exec Launches $1.5B AI Manufacturing Startup Arda The Tech Buzz
items.why_zh: 前OpenAI高管创业做AI制造，显示AI正从软件向工业制造等实体领域扩展。
items.why_en: A former OpenAI executive launching an AI manufacturing startup shows AI expanding from software into industrial manufacturing.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek开源DeepInfer推理框架，助力降低AI部署成本 提供者 Investing.com
items.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources DeepInfer Inference Framework to Cut AI Deployment Costs
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek开源DeepInfer推理框架，助力降低AI部署成本 提供者 Investing.com 英为财情 Investing.com
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced DeepInfer, an inference framework aimed at reducing AI deployment costs. The framework could make inference deployment and optimization easier for developers and enterprises, though performance benchmarks and licensing details were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: DeepInfer开源直指AI部署成本痛点，可能加速推理应用的普及。
items.why_en: Open-sourcing DeepInfer targets AI deployment costs and could accelerate adoption of inference applications.

items.title_zh: Waymo 计划明年进军西班牙市场，在该国首都马德里推出自动驾驶网约车服务
items.title_en: Waymo Plans Autonomous Ride-Hailing Launch in Madrid in 2027
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，Waymo 今天宣布，公司计划 2027 年在西班牙推出完全自动驾驶网约车服务， 首站定在该国首都马德里 。 Waymo 表示，搭载电动动力系统的捷豹 I-PACE 汽车将在未来几天内，陆续出现在马德里街头。 在正式开展自动驾驶运营之前 ， 上述车辆将由专业人员负责驾驶 。公司将按照西班牙交通总局（IT之家注：DGT）的框架开展业务。 同时 Waymo 透露，公司计划今年在伦敦推出服务，2027 年进军日本东京，并于 2028 年进入加拿大多伦多市场。 其中东京业务将与日本交通株式会社 、 GO 展开合作 ，但仍有待监管部门批准；多伦多业务则将与 Element Fleet Management 合作开展。 Waymo 称其自动驾驶出租车已积累超 4 亿公里安全数据。与人类驾驶员相比，Waymo 涉及严重伤害的碰撞事故减少了 95%。
items.summary_en: Waymo plans to launch fully autonomous ride-hailing in Madrid in 2027, with Jaguar I-PACE vehicles appearing on city streets soon under professional drivers before operations begin. The company also outlined plans for London, Tokyo and Toronto.
items.why_zh: Waymo进军马德里是其全球扩张的重要一步，也考验自动驾驶在欧洲的监管与商业化。
items.why_en: Waymo’s Madrid plan is a key step in global expansion and tests autonomous driving regulation and commercialization in Europe.

items.title_zh: 美国发布针对DeepSeek的禁令，商务部回应
items.title_en: US Issues Ban Targeting DeepSeek; Commerce Ministry Responds
items.summary_zh: 美国发布针对DeepSeek的禁令，商务部回应 凤凰网
items.summary_en: The United States has issued a ban targeting Chinese AI company DeepSeek, according to Phoenix Net. China's Ministry of Commerce responded to the move, though specific terms and response details were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 这一事件反映中美在AI领域的监管摩擦升级，可能影响DeepSeek的海外业务环境。
items.why_en: It highlights escalating US-China regulatory friction in AI and could affect DeepSeek's overseas business environment.

items.title_zh: AI进化速递丨DeepSeek进一步将内部推理框架DeepInfer全面开源
items.title_en: DeepSeek Fully Open-Sources Internal Inference Framework DeepInfer
items.summary_zh: AI进化速递丨DeepSeek进一步将内部推理框架DeepInfer全面开源 新浪新闻_手机新浪网
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has fully open-sourced DeepInfer, its internal inference framework. The release gives developers access to the technology behind its model inference and is expected to help optimize efficiency and lower deployment barriers.
items.why_zh: 推理成本是AI规模化应用的关键瓶颈，开源内部框架有助于降低部署门槛并扩大DeepSeek的生态影响。
items.why_en: Inference cost is a key bottleneck for scaling AI, and open-sourcing an internal framework can lower deployment barriers and expand DeepSeek's ecosystem influence.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek宣布：全面开源内部推理框架

items.summary_en: DeepSeek has announced the full open-sourcing of its internal inference framework. The framework supports model inference services, and its release allows developers to optimize and deploy inference workloads.
items.why_zh: 开源推理框架有望降低AI推理部署成本，并增强DeepSeek在开发者生态中的影响力。
items.why_en: Open-sourcing the inference framework could lower AI deployment costs and strengthen DeepSeek's influence in the developer ecosystem.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek开源内部推理框架，瞄准降低AI运行成本
items.title_en: DeepSeek Unveils Open-Source Tool to Help Cut AI Operating Costs
items.summary_zh: 据彭博社报道，DeepSeek发布开源工具DeepInfer，用于帮助降低AI运行成本。该工具原本是DeepSeek的内部推理框架，此次全面开源，开发者可用来优化模型推理服务。在AI算力与推理开支高企的背景下，降低运行成本正成为行业关注重点。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek Unveils Open-Source Tool to Help Cut AI Operating Costs Bloomberg.com
items.why_zh: 降低推理成本关系到AI应用的规模化落地，DeepSeek的开源举措可能加剧推理优化领域的竞争。
items.why_en: Lowering inference costs matters for scaling AI applications, and DeepSeek's open-source move could intensify competition in inference optimization.

items.title_zh: QuestMobile榜单发布：豆包4.19亿断层领先 千问增速5076%
items.title_en: QuestMobile: Doubao Leads with 419 Million Users as Qwen Surges 5,076%

items.why_en: User-scale and growth data reveal the competitive landscape of China's AI apps, with both dominant leaders and fast-rising products.

items.summary_en: Google and Synaptics unveil new AI chips for wearables and industrial devices, powered by open-source Coral technology VentureBeat

items.why_en: Competition in edge AI chips is heating up, and open-source Coral technology could lower the barrier for device makers to deploy on-device AI.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 抢在 Anthropic 预期 IPO 前冲刺 300 亿美元融资
items.title_en: OpenAI is racing to raise $30 billion before Anthropic's expected IPO
items.summary_zh: 据 Quartz 报道，OpenAI 正在加速推进一轮规模达 300 亿美元的融资，时间窗口被压缩在竞争对手 Anthropic 预期启动 IPO 之前。报道将这笔巨额募资描述为一场与 Anthropic 上市进程的“赛跑”，反映两家头部大模型公司在资本市场的直接争夺。目前披露的信息仅涉及融资规模与时间节奏，具体的投资方构成、估值条款及资金用途尚未公开。若融资与 Anthropic 的上市计划如期推进，两家公司的资金储备与公开市场曝光度对比将出现新的变化。
items.summary_en: OpenAI is racing to raise $30 billion before Anthropic's expected IPO Quartz
items.why_zh: 头部大模型公司正把竞争延伸到资本市场，谁能先拿到更多资金与公开市场资源，可能影响下一阶段的算力与人才布局。
items.why_en: The race shows frontier AI competition moving into capital markets, where funding and public-listing timing could shape the next phase of compute and talent advantages.

items.title_zh: 独家：AI 安全公司 Gray Swan 重启“红队竞技场”大赛，瞄准 AI 智能体时代
items.title_en: Exclusive: AI security company Gray Swan relaunches its red-teaming Arena contest for the era of AI agents
items.summary_zh: 据 Fortune 独家报道，AI 安全公司 Gray Swan 重新启动了其“红队竞技场”（Arena）竞赛，并把重点转向 AI 智能体（AI agents）时代的安全挑战。该赛事以对抗性测试为核心，让参赛者尝试发现模型与智能体系统中的漏洞。此次重启意味着评测对象从单纯的模型输出，扩展到具备自主调用工具与执行多步任务能力的智能体系统。报道未披露赛事的具体奖金、赛程安排或参与方名单。随着智能体在企业场景中加速落地，其权限、工具调用与行为链路的可控性正成为安全社区关注的新焦点。
items.summary_en: Exclusive: AI security company Gray Swan relaunches its red-teaming Arena contest for the era of AI agents Fortune
items.why_zh: AI 智能体能调用工具并自主执行多步任务，其安全风险比单纯文本模型更复杂，红队竞赛成为提前暴露漏洞的重要方式。
items.why_en: AI agents can call tools and act autonomously, making their security risks more complex than plain text models, and red-team contests help surface flaws early.

items.title_zh: 重磅！DeepSeek宣布开源原生推理框架
items.title_en: DeepSeek Announces Open-Sourcing of Its Native Inference Framework
items.summary_zh: 重磅！DeepSeek宣布开源原生推理框架 21财经
items.summary_en: DeepSeek announced it is open-sourcing its native inference framework, according to 21 Caijing. The report did not detail licensing, technical specifics or release version.
items.why_zh: 推理框架决定模型部署的效率与成本，开源有助于开发者绕开单一供应商，扩大 DeepSeek 在生态中的影响力。
items.why_en: Inference frameworks determine deployment efficiency and cost, so open-sourcing can broaden DeepSeek's ecosystem influence beyond its models.

items.title_zh: 刚刚，DeepSeek开源自家推理框架！
items.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources Its In-House Inference Framework
items.summary_zh: 刚刚，DeepSeek开源自家推理框架！ 搜狐
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced its in-house inference framework, Sohu reported. The brief report did not name the framework or specify supported hardware and performance figures.
items.why_zh: 模型之外的基础设施开源，让外界能够直接复用并检验 DeepSeek 的推理技术路线。
items.why_en: Open-sourcing infrastructure beyond the model lets outsiders directly reuse and scrutinize DeepSeek's inference stack.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek全面开源推理框架：兼容英伟达、华为昇腾芯片，单集群日吞吐155万亿Token，每卡每小时收入38美元
items.title_en: DeepSeek Fully Open-Sources Inference Framework, Supporting Nvidia and Huawei Ascend Chips
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek全面开源推理框架：兼容英伟达、华为昇腾芯片，单集群日吞吐155万亿Token，每卡每小时收入38美元 华尔街见闻
items.summary_en: DeepSeek fully open-sourced its inference framework, which supports both Nvidia and Huawei Ascend chips, with one cluster handling 155 trillion tokens per day and $38 revenue per GPU-hour, Wallstreetcn reported.
items.why_zh: 同时兼容英伟达与昇腾并公布吞吐与单卡收入，意味着开源推理栈开始具备可量化的商业可行性，也利好国产算力生态。
items.why_en: Support for both Nvidia and Ascend plus published throughput and per-GPU revenue figures make the open stack commercially quantifiable and bolster domestic chip ecosystems.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek近千亿融资收官：投前估值5000亿元，产业资本集体入局

items.why_zh: 近千亿元融资与产业资本集体入局，将显著影响 DeepSeek 的算力投入节奏，也改变国内大模型竞争的资金格局。
items.why_en: A near-100-billion-yuan round backed by industrial capital could significantly shape DeepSeek's compute spending and the domestic foundation-model funding landscape.

items.title_zh: 面向托管大模型身份替换的审计辅助摘要信道验证方法
items.title_en: Auditor-Assisted Summary-Channel Verification for Hosted LLM Identity Substitution
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文研究托管式大模型服务中的“身份替换”问题：服务商常把模型身份作为产品卖点，但外部用户与审计者往往无法核查某次请求究竟由哪个模型配置完成。作者提出一种审计辅助机制——在部署前由可信审计方登记所声称的模型身份并准备验证材料，审计时仅凭所声称的身份与已发布的输出即可验证，无需访问模型内部、推理日志、路由决策或服务商元数据。论文据此提出名为 SUMMARK 的摘要信道水印方案。该工作试图在完全不透明运行时的情况下，为模型身份声明提供可外部检验的依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.25982v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hosted LLM services increasingly expose model identity as a product claim, but external users and auditors often cannot inspect which model configuration served a request. We study an auditor-assisted regime in which a trusted auditor enrolls claimed identities and prepares verification material before deployment, while audit-time verification uses only the claimed identity and released output, without runtime access to model internals, inference logs, routing decisions, or provider metadata. We propose SUMMARK, a summary-channel watermarking f…
items.why_zh: 当模型身份本身成为商品声明，能否被外部独立验证直接关系到托管 AI 服务的可信度与审计可行性。
items.why_en: When model identity is itself a product claim, independent external verification is essential to trust and auditability in hosted AI services.

items.title_zh: 边缘网络中基于动态原型调节的通信高效联邦域泛化
items.title_en: Communication-Efficient Federated Domain Generalization in Edge Networks via Dynamic Prototype Regulation
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文关注在物联网边缘网络中部署视觉语言模型（VLM）时的联邦学习难题。作者指出两类突出挑战：模型参数规模大，在带宽受限的衰落信道上会拉高上行传输时延；数据呈非独立同分布（Non-IID），会加剧客户端漂移。现有特征对齐方案往往引入额外计算，占用本应用于无线参数传输的时隙，从而进一步增加开销。论文提出以动态原型调节实现通信高效的联邦域泛化，力图在受限无线环境下平衡传输成本与模型泛化能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.25810v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a distributed paradigm for Internet of Things (IoT) edge networks. However, deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) over wireless edge networks presents distinct challenges: large model parameters increase uplink transmission latency over bandwidth-constrained fading channels, and non-independent and identically distributed (Non-IID) data exacerbates client drift. Existing feature alignment solutions often introduce auxiliary computations that consume time slots allocated for wireless parameter transmission, increasing…
items.why_zh: 边缘设备上的大模型协同训练受限于带宽与数据异构，降低通信开销的方法决定了这类部署能否真正落地。
items.why_en: Collaborative training of large models on edge devices is constrained by bandwidth and data heterogeneity, so cutting communication overhead determines whether such deployments are practical.

items.title_zh: PALM：面向金融语言模型的时点适配方法
items.title_en: PALM: Point-in-Time Adaptation for Financial Language Models
items.summary_zh: 金融回测中使用的语言模型存在“前视偏差”：如果模型训练所用文本发表于研究区间之后，它实际上已经见过自己要预测的结果。为规避这一问题，业界采用“时点（PIT）语言模型”——在按时间过滤的语料上预训练，并按日历年发布检查点，每个检查点标注明确的知识截止日期。但这种做法意味着每增加一年就要多跑一次预训练，而这次预训练是否必要此前从未被验证。这篇论文提出 PALM（时点适配），系统考察能否用适配手段替代逐年重训，从而在保持时点一致性的同时降低发布新检查点的成本。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30316v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Language models used in financial backtests suffer from look-ahead bias, as a model trained on text published after the study period has already observed the outcomes it is asked to predict. To handle this issue, point-in-time (PIT) language models are pretrained on chronologically filtered corpora and released as one checkpoint per calendar year, each with a documented cutoff. However, each additional year costs another pretraining run, and whether that run is necessary has never been tested. In this paper, we show that a newer checkpoint is…
items.why_zh: 它直击金融 NLP 评测中长期被忽视的前视偏差与预训练成本问题，为时点一致的模型更新提供了更廉价的路径。
items.why_en: It tackles look-ahead bias and repeated pretraining costs in financial NLP, offering a cheaper route to chronologically consistent model updates.

items.title_zh: 函数级漏洞评分更多反映评测协议而非模型能力
items.title_en: A Function-Level Vulnerability Score Measures Flag Rate More Than the Model: Protocol Effects on Paired Benchmarks
items.summary_zh: 语言模型正越来越多地被当作漏洞检测器来评测，但相近模型在不同论文中得到的分数差异巨大。该研究在固定模型输出的前提下，量化了这种差异中有多少来自评测协议本身。实验采用配对测试：模型必须标出存在漏洞的函数，并在修复提交后确认同一函数的对应版本已无漏洞。作者逐项改变已发表评测中做法不一的三个选择——度量指标、判定结果抽取方式、输出预算——并在五个公开数据集上评测了七个前沿模型与大型开源模型。结果显示，函数级漏洞分数更多衡量的是“标记率”，而不是模型本身的检测能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32890v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Language models are increasingly evaluated as vulnerability detectors, and scores reported for similar models differ widely between papers. We measured how much of that difference evaluation protocol accounts for, with model outputs held fixed. In a paired test, a model must flag a vulnerable function and clear its version after a fixing commit. Three choices that published evaluations make differently were varied one at a time: metric, verdict extraction and output budget. Seven frontier and large open models were evaluated on five released…
items.why_zh: 它提醒研究者和采购方：漏洞检测榜单上的分数差异可能只是协议差异，跨论文比较模型需要先统一评测口径。
items.why_en: It warns that leaderboard gaps in vulnerability detection may be protocol artifacts, so cross-paper model comparisons require standardized evaluation.

items.title_zh: AdaptLSTM：应对分布漂移的云负载高效自适应在线学习
items.title_en: AdaptLSTM: Efficient Adaptive Online Learning for Cloud Workload Forecasting under Distribution Drift
items.summary_zh: 在超大规模云服务中，准确的负载预测对弹性资源调度至关重要，而爆款内容、产品发布和用户行为变化引发的分布漂移会让离线训练的模型迅速失效。朴素的在线学习虽能恢复精度，却带来难以承受的每步计算开销。为此，作者提出 AdaptLSTM 自适应在线框架：通过经验证集校准的阈值检测漂移，并只做选择性的、有针对性的模型更新。在阿里巴巴机器集群轨迹数据上，AdaptLSTM 以远低于朴素在线学习的成本，恢复了后者所带来的 54% 的精度提升。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.12265v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurate workload forecasting is critical for elastic resource provisioning in web-scale cloud services, where distribution shifts driven by viral content, product launches, and user behavior degrade offline-trained models rapidly. Naive online learning recovers accuracy but incurs prohibitive per-step compute cost. We propose AdaptLSTM, an adaptive online framework that detects drift via validation-calibrated thresholds and applies selective, targeted updates. On the Alibaba Machine Trace, AdaptLSTM recovers 54\% of Naive Online's improvemen…
items.why_zh: 它在漂移检测与更新成本之间取得折中，让在线自适应在真实云调度场景中变得可负担。
items.why_en: It makes online adaptation affordable in real cloud scheduling by balancing drift detection against per-step update cost.

items.title_zh: QuestMobile榜单发布：豆包4.19亿断层领先 千问增速5076%
items.title_en: QuestMobile Ranking: Doubao Leads at 419 Million, Qwen Grows 5,076%
items.summary_zh: QuestMobile榜单发布：豆包4.19亿断层领先 千问增速5076% 驱动之家
items.summary_en: QuestMobile's latest ranking shows ByteDance's Doubao far ahead at 419 million users, while Alibaba's Qwen posted growth of 5,076%, making it one of the fastest-growing AI apps in China.
items.why_zh: 榜单揭示了国内 AI 应用头部集中与高速增长并存的竞争格局。
items.why_en: The ranking reveals a Chinese AI app market that is both concentrated at the top and rapidly expanding.

items.title_zh: 美国禁止政府使用DeepSeek
items.title_en: US bans government use of DeepSeek
items.summary_zh: 美国禁止政府使用DeepSeek 新浪网
items.summary_en: The United States has barred government use of DeepSeek, according to a Sina report. The report does not detail the scope or issuing authority, but the core development is that US government entities may no longer use the Chinese AI company's models and services.
items.why_zh: 政府层面的禁用令把 AI 模型的地缘与合规风险摆上台面，可能影响企业的模型选型。
items.why_en: A government-level ban puts geopolitical and compliance risk around AI models on the table, potentially shaping enterprise model choices.

items.title_zh: 美国多州跨党派联合对 OpenAI 提起诉讼
items.title_en: Bipartisan group of states files lawsuits against OpenAI
items.summary_zh: 据 MS NOW 报道，美国一个由两党州组成的群体对 OpenAI 提起了诉讼。报道以“跨党派”强调这一行动并非单一政治阵营主导，显示州一级监管者对 AI 公司的关注正在形成合力。目前公开信息仅涉及诉讼的发起方与对象，具体指控内容、诉求与涉及州的数量尚未在摘要中给出。此举是州层面针对头部 AI 实验室法律行动持续升温的最新一例。
items.summary_en: Bipartisan group of states files lawsuits against OpenAI MS NOW
items.why_zh: 州级跨党派诉讼意味着 AI 头部公司面临的法律与监管压力正从联邦层面扩散开来。
items.why_en: Bipartisan state-level lawsuits signal that legal and regulatory pressure on leading AI firms is broadening beyond the federal level.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 收购 Orchestra Bio，加码药物研发 AI
items.title_en: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to boost drug development AI, Axios reports
items.summary_zh: 据 Axios 报道，OpenAI 已收购 Orchestra Bio，此举意在强化其在药物研发方向的 AI 能力。Orchestra Bio 是一家与生物医药相关的公司，此次并购被解读为 OpenAI 向生命科学应用场景延伸的一步。交易的具体金额与条款未在报道中披露。若整合顺利，OpenAI 有望把模型能力更直接地对接到药物发现与研发流程中，这将使其与既有的 AI 制药公司形成更直接的竞争关系。
items.summary_en: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to boost drug development AI, Axios reports Investing.com
items.why_zh: 头部模型公司直接买下生物医药标的，说明 AI 制药正从合作走向深度整合。
items.why_en: A leading model developer buying into biotech shows AI drug discovery shifting from partnerships toward deeper integration.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 宣布收购 Orchestra Bio
items.title_en: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 方面发布消息称已收购 Orchestra Bio。该消息与此前 Axios 的独家报道相互印证，确认了这笔交易的存在。公开信息目前仅确认收购事实本身，交易金额、团队安置方式与具体产品整合计划尚未在披露中展开。对 OpenAI 而言，将生物医药方向的团队纳入体系，是其把通用模型能力推向垂直科研场景的又一步。
items.summary_en: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio OpenAI
items.why_zh: 官方确认让此前传闻落地，也显示 OpenAI 在生命科学方向的布局已进入执行阶段。
items.why_en: Official confirmation turns earlier reporting into fact and shows OpenAI's life-sciences push is now in execution mode.

items.title_zh: Axios 独家：OpenAI 已完成对 Orchestra Bio 的收购
items.title_en: Exclusive: OpenAI has acquired Orchestra Bio
items.summary_zh: Axios 以独家报道形式披露，OpenAI 已完成对 Orchestra Bio 的收购。该报道是这一交易最早公开的信息来源之一，随后得到 OpenAI 方面的确认。报道聚焦于交易本身，尚未展开披露收购价格、监管审批环节以及 Orchestra Bio 团队在 OpenAI 内部的具体定位。结合 OpenAI 近期的动向，这笔收购被视为其在药物研发 AI 方向上的一次实质投入。
items.summary_en: Exclusive: OpenAI has acquired Orchestra Bio Axios
items.why_zh: 独家披露抢在官方确认之前，凸显 AI 巨头在生物医药领域的并购动作正受到高度关注。
items.why_en: An exclusive that preceded official confirmation highlights how closely AI giants' biotech M&A moves are being watched.

items.title_zh: 富国银行用AI改造银行的四大战略要点
items.title_en: 4 keys to Wells Fargo’s strategy to transform the bank with AI
items.summary_zh: 雅虎财经刊文梳理富国银行（Wells Fargo）以人工智能推动银行转型的战略，并以“四个关键点”为框架进行解读。文章关注这家大型银行如何把AI纳入业务与运营转型，而非仅限于单一产品发布。对于观察金融业AI落地的人来说，这一框架有助于理解传统银行推进AI时的重点与难点。具体举措与成效仍需以原文披露为准。
items.summary_en: 4 keys to Wells Fargo’s strategy to transform the bank with AI Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 大型银行的AI转型路径，是观察金融业AI落地节奏与重点的样本。
items.why_en: A major bank’s AI transformation offers a benchmark for how AI is being adopted across finance.

items.title_zh: Meta 的 Muse 上线 40 天美国下载量破千万，史上仅 11 款应用做到
items.title_en: Meta’s Muse hits 10M U.S. downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
items.summary_zh: Meta 的 AI 伴侣应用 Muse 在上线头 40 天内美国下载量突破 1000 万，成为极少数达成这一里程碑的应用之一，加入包括 Threads 在内的精英俱乐部。新数据还显示，Muse 的用户留存率高于其 AI 竞品。这表明尽管 AI 伴侣类产品竞争激烈，Meta 凭借分发优势与产品设计在早期增长和留存上双双领先。
items.summary_en: Meta's AI companion Muse has surpassed 10 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days, joining an exclusive group of apps that includes Threads. New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.
items.why_zh: 下载与留存双高的早期数据，说明 AI 伴侣赛道正从尝鲜走向规模化，而 Meta 的分发能力构成明显优势。
items.why_en: Strong early downloads plus better retention signal that AI companions are scaling beyond novelty, with Meta's distribution advantage showing.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek 推出开源推理工具，加大对 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的施压
items.title_en: DeepSeek Dials Up the Pressure on OpenAI and Anthropic With Open-Source Inference Tool
items.summary_zh: 据 Gizmodo 报道，DeepSeek 发布了一款开源推理工具，进一步加大了对 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的竞争压力。开源推理组件的推出，意味着开发者可以更低成本地部署与运行模型推理，而非依赖闭源厂商的托管服务。此举延续了 DeepSeek 以开放权重与开源工具切入市场、压缩专有模型厂商定价与生态空间的策略。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek Dials Up the Pressure on OpenAI and Anthropic With Open-Source Inference Tool Gizmodo
items.why_zh: 开源推理层直接冲击闭源厂商的调用收入，是模型竞争从权重延伸到部署工具链的信号。
items.why_en: Open-sourcing the inference layer threatens proprietary API revenue and shows competition shifting from weights to the deployment toolchain.

items.title_zh: 千亿美元网络安全公司创始人：学会“构建与销售”才能让职业不被 AI 取代
items.title_en: To AI-proof your career, learn to 'build and sell,' says $100 billion cybersecurity firm founder
items.summary_zh: 据 CNBC 报道，一家市值约 1000 亿美元的网络安全公司创始人为“如何让职业不被 AI 取代”给出建议：掌握“构建与销售”两类能力。其核心逻辑是，能够亲手把东西做出来、并把它卖出去的人，在 AI 时代更难被替代。这一观点强调复合型、面向结果的能力组合，而非单一的技术或职能技能。
items.summary_en: To AI-proof your career, learn to 'build and sell,' says $100 billion cybersecurity firm founder CNBC
items.why_zh: 来自一线企业家的判断，为普通从业者在 AI 冲击下如何配置技能提供了一个务实方向。
items.why_en: A practitioner's take offers a pragmatic skills direction for workers facing AI-driven job disruption.

items.title_zh: 好 AI 变坏会怎样？研究者正在寻找那个临界点
items.title_en: What happens when good AI goes bad? Researchers studying the tipping point
items.summary_zh: 据 KGNS 报道，研究人员正在研究 AI 系统从“表现良好”转向“行为失范”的临界点，试图弄清这种转变在什么条件下发生。报道聚焦的问题是：原本可靠的模型为何会在某些情境下出现有害或不可预期的行为，以及能否在这一拐点出现之前识别并加以干预。相关研究有助于为模型部署中的监测与风险预警提供依据。
items.summary_en: What happens when good AI goes bad? Researchers studying the tipping point KGNS
items.why_zh: 识别“变坏”的临界点，是把 AI 安全从事故后复盘转向事前预警的关键一步。
items.why_en: Pinpointing the tipping point moves AI safety from post-incident analysis toward early warning.

items.title_zh: 谷歌前CEO施密特早期押注Anthropic，IPO后或膨胀至200亿美元
items.title_en: Ex-Google CEO Eric Schmidt’s early Anthropic bet could balloon to $20B in blockbuster IPO

items.summary_en: Ex-Google CEO Eric Schmidt’s early Anthropic bet could balloon to $20B in blockbuster IPO New York Post
items.why_zh: 早期个人投资在头部AI实验室IPO预期下可能获得巨额回报，反映AI资本热潮的规模。
items.why_en: A single early angel-style bet potentially worth $20B illustrates the scale of the AI capital boom and IPO expectations.

items.title_zh: 前英伟达高管、现投资人：物理AI还处在“乐高时代”
items.title_en: Ex-Nvidia-turned-VC Amulya Vishwanath: ‘Physical AI is in it’s LEGO era’
items.summary_zh: 从英伟达转做风险投资的Amulya Vishwanath在TechCrunch的Equity播客中表示，机器人领域的“ChatGPT时刻”正是所有人都在等待的时刻，但目前尚未到来。他用“乐高时代”来形容物理AI（具身智能/机器人）的现状：基础模块已经具备、拼接与搭建仍在早期阶段。这一比喻意味着行业距离成熟可用的通用机器人能力还有明显距离，但构建模块正在逐步就位。
items.summary_en: It’s the moment everyone is waiting for — the ChatGPT moment for robotics, Amulya Vishwanath explained to TechCrunch’s Equity.
items.why_zh: 一线投资人对具身智能成熟度的判断，有助于校准市场对机器人热潮的预期。
items.why_en: A frontline investor's take helps calibrate expectations for the robotics and embodied-AI hype cycle.

items.title_zh: 大规模IPO在即，AI公司开始筹划如何“分享财富”
items.title_en: Ahead of massive IPOs, AI companies are sketching plans to share their wealth
items.summary_zh: 据WKMG报道，在多家AI公司筹备大规模IPO之际，这些企业开始勾勒与员工、社区或其他相关方分享财富的方案。报道将这类安排与上市前的舆论和治理压力联系起来，说明AI公司在创造巨额估值的同时，也在思考收益分配问题。具体方案细节尚未在摘要中披露，但“分享财富”已成为上市叙事的一部分。
items.summary_en: Ahead of massive IPOs, AI companies are sketching plans to share their wealth WKMG
items.why_zh: AI巨额财富如何分配正成为上市前必须回应的治理与社会议题。

items.title_zh: 企业AI的新经济学
items.title_en: The new economics of enterprise AI
items.summary_zh: 文章用企业刚发现电力作类比：早期只有少数机器用电，没人担心效率；一旦电力成为基础设施，每个流程都依赖它，问题就变成“如何高效使用”。企业AI正经历类似转变，从孤立的聊天机器人和copilot试验，走向由模型、agent和数据相互连接的生产级基础层。随着AI成为业务底座，效率和成本治理的重要性上升。
items.summary_en: Imagine your company just discovered electricity. At first only a few machines run on it, and nobody worries about efficiency — consumption is low and the value is obvious. But once electricity becomes infrastructure, every process depends on it, and the question changes from “can we use it?” to “how efficiently are we using it?” Enterprise AI is going through the same shift. What began as isolated chatbot and copilot experiments is becoming a foundational layer of the business, with models, agents, and data increasingly interconnected in production workloads. The impor…
items.why_zh: 企业AI从试验走向基础设施后，效率与成本治理成为核心竞争力。
items.why_en: As enterprise AI becomes infrastructure, efficiency and cost governance become core competitive issues.

items.title_zh: 英伟达黄仁勋劝诫欧洲各国：别再对 AI 过度犹疑，否则将被时代甩在身后
items.title_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Tells Europe Not to Over-Hesitate on AI
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，据《商业内幕》今天报道，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋过去一周访欧期间，向欧洲各国领导人传递了明确信号：必须摆脱束缚大胆行动， 否则欧洲可能永远无法参与 AI 竞赛 。 IT之家从原报道获悉，黄仁勋过去几天先后访问法国、瑞典、英国和德国，为今日在柏林开幕的 GTC 大会做准备。他在此期间多次强调，欧洲需要加快 AI 发展步伐，不应过度依赖监管。 周一晚间，黄仁勋与德国总理弗里德里希 · 默茨展开对话。当谈到欧洲如何监管 AI 时，黄仁勋认为安全必须放在首位，但决策者不能只拿着监管的大棒，就指望技术领先他国。 黄仁勋表示：“ 如果这个行业无法蓬勃发展 ， 那没什么可监管的 。德国需要培育本土 AI 产业，同时确保其发展安全。” 在他看来，政策制定者应重点监管 AI 应用，就像监管互联网产品一样， 而不是试图对底层技术进行全面监管 。 默茨回应称，欧洲正努力寻找创新与监管的平衡。他认为“完全不监管”不是正确答案，但过于严格的规则同样不可取。 黄仁勋回应道：“给德国一个机会，给这个行业一个机会。” 此外，黄仁勋与默茨还将 AI 描述为一种潜在的解决方案，有望帮助德国摆脱经济低迷。黄仁勋认为，德国的制造业、工程技术专长是优势。借助 AI，他们可以将这些长项转化为竞争力，在下一场技术竞赛中占据有利位置。 几天前，黄仁勋同样在英国传递了紧迫的信息。他认为英国人总是纠结…
items.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, during a tour of France, Sweden, the U.K. and Germany, urged European leaders to move faster on AI and avoid over-regulation. In a conversation with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, he argued for regulating AI applications rather than trying to fully regulate underlying technology, while Merz stressed a balance between innovation and oversight.
items.why_zh: 英伟达CEO公开向欧洲施压，将影响欧洲AI监管与产业政策辩论。
items.why_en: Nvidia’s CEO is publicly pressuring Europe, which could shape its AI regulation and industrial policy debate.

items.title_en: Huawei Unveils Nvidia H20 Alternative in Apparent Signal to Washington
items.summary_zh: 似乎在向美国示威…中国华为发布“英伟达H20”的替代品 朝鮮日報中文版
items.summary_en: Huawei has released a product positioned as an alternative to Nvidia's H20 chip, a move read as a signal to Washington amid ongoing export controls. Details on specs and availability were not disclosed in the summary.
items.why_zh: 国产替代能否填补受限芯片空缺，直接关系到中国 AI 算力供给与出口管制的实际效力。
items.why_en: Whether domestic alternatives can fill the gap left by restricted chips directly affects China's AI compute supply and the impact of export controls.

items.title_zh: Anthropic提议的AI监管含“至少50人死亡”才停模型门槛
items.title_en: Anthropic’s Proposed Regulations for AI Include a Death Threshold of at Least 50 People Before Halting Models
items.summary_zh: 据Truthout报道，Anthropic提出的AI监管建议中包含一个与死亡人数相关的门槛：至少50人死亡才会停止模型。报道将这一设定作为其拟议监管框架的争议点，但提供的摘要未展开具体适用范围、条文措辞或Anthropic的完整解释。该门槛引发外界对AI安全监管严格程度和风险容忍度的关注。
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s Proposed Regulations for AI Include a Death Threshold of at Least 50 People Before Halting Models Truthout
items.why_zh: AI安全监管中的阈值设定直接关系风险容忍度与监管严格程度。
items.why_en: Thresholds in AI safety regulation directly affect risk tolerance and regulatory strictness.

items.summary_en: Nucleus Research Announces Top Ten Predictions for 2027 PR Newswire
items.why_zh: 研究机构的年度预测可为企业与投资者提供趋势参考。

items.title_zh: Anthropic 洽谈与 Nscale 的第二笔数十亿美元级交易
items.title_en: Anthropic in talks for second multibillion-dollar Nscale deal - CNBC
items.summary_zh: 据 CNBC 报道，AI 公司 Anthropic 正与算力供应商 Nscale 就第二笔规模达数十亿美元的合作进行洽谈。若交易达成，这将是双方短期内第二次大额算力合作，凸显 Anthropic 在模型训练与推理上持续扩张的算力需求。目前交易尚处于谈判阶段，具体金额、交付形式和时间表等细节均未披露。
items.summary_en: Anthropic in talks for second multibillion-dollar Nscale deal - CNBC Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: AI 巨头对算力的争夺正从单笔采购转向长期、连续的巨额合作，反映训练与推理成本仍在快速攀升。
items.why_en: The deal shows how AI labs are locking in successive multibillion-dollar compute contracts as training and inference costs keep climbing.

items.title_zh: 中方回应美机构禁用DeepSeek

items.summary_en: China pushed back after US agencies were directed to stop using the Chinese AI model DeepSeek, arguing that tech and trade issues should not be politicized. The dispute highlights growing friction over AI regulation and market access between the two countries.
items.why_zh: 政府层面的禁用指令可能改变 AI 模型的跨境采用格局，并加剧中美科技脱钩压力。
items.why_en: Government-level bans can reshape how AI models are adopted across borders and deepen US-China tech decoupling.

items.title_zh: 石溪大学研究者获 DARPA 资助，推动 AI 更节能
items.title_en: Stony Brook Researchers Receive DARPA Funding to Help Make AI More Energy Efficient
items.summary_zh: 美国石溪大学（Stony Brook University）的研究人员获得 DARPA（美国国防高级研究计划局）资助，用于提升人工智能的能效。项目聚焦于降低 AI 计算过程中的能耗，以应对模型规模扩大带来的电力与算力压力。校方新闻稿公布了这一资助消息，但未在摘要中披露具体金额与技术路线。
items.summary_en: Stony Brook Researchers Receive DARPA Funding to Help Make AI More Energy Efficient SBU News
items.why_zh: AI 能耗已成为制约规模化部署的关键瓶颈，国防机构的投入会加速节能技术的实用化。
items.why_en: Energy consumption is a key bottleneck for scaling AI, and defense funding could speed efficiency research toward practical use.

items.title_zh: 智能电视广告引不满，部分用户借助 Claude 等 AI 智能体清理广告和预装应用
items.title_en: Users Turn to Claude and Other AI Agents to Strip Smart TV Ads and Bloatware
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，据 TechCrunch、Mashable 当地时间 10 月 19 日报道，部分开发者和普通用户开始借助 Claude Code 等 AI 工具，对智能电视中的广告和预装软件进行清理、禁用追踪功能，以减少广告干扰并改善操作流畅度。 其中一个名为 CleanYourTV 的项目由开发者 Gathin T. 发起。他将父母使用的小米电视型号提供给 Claude Code，后者通过 Wi-Fi 连接电视，禁用了 25 个小米软件包，并生成了一个新的启动器，将原本的电视主屏幕替换为更简洁的界面。 Gathin T. 随后公开了相关提示词和项目代码，并称接下来两天有数千名用户尝试在自己的设备上进行类似改造。 另一个名为 DumbTV 的项目由开发者 Muzzammil Yasin Sabuwala 开发，目标是减少电视广告、用户行为追踪和不必要的软件更新。Sabuwala 告诉 TechCrunch，该项目使用了 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Claude Opus 5.5 和 Claude Sonnet 5.5 等模型辅助开发。 据 TechCrunch 报道，DumbTV 已在 Fire TV Edition 电视以及索尼、TCL、飞利浦、海信、小米等品牌的 Android TV 或 Google TV 设备上进行端到端测试，也支持 Nvid…
items.summary_en: Developers and everyday users are using AI coding agents like Claude Code to strip ads, bloatware and tracking from smart TVs, per TechCrunch and Mashable. One project, CleanYourTV, disabled 25 Xiaomi packages and generated a cleaner launcher, drawing thousands of imitators; a second, DumbTV, was built with help from DeepSeek and Claude models and tested across Fire TV and multiple Android TV/Google TV brands.
items.why_zh: AI 智能体首次被大规模用于“改造”消费电子设备的系统生态，凸显智能电视广告商业模式与用户权益的紧张关系。
items.why_en: AI agents are being used at scale to modify consumer devices, exposing the tension between smart-TV ad business models and user control.

items.title_zh: 美国指示各机构停用DeepSeek，中方：反对将科技经贸问题政治化
items.title_en: US Directs Agencies to Stop Using DeepSeek; China Opposes Politicizing Tech Issues
items.summary_zh: 美国指示各机构停用DeepSeek，中方：反对将科技经贸问题政治化 经济观察网
items.summary_en: The US has directed government agencies to stop using the Chinese AI model DeepSeek, prompting Beijing to object to what it calls the politicization of tech and trade issues. The directive targets public-sector use and could affect DeepSeek's prospects in the US market.
items.why_zh: 针对政府机构的禁用指令为其他国家提供了先例，可能加速 AI 模型市场的阵营化。
items.why_en: A government-wide ban sets a precedent that could accelerate the split of the global AI model market into blocs.

items.title_zh: 海盗船推出 SABRE v3 PRO PureVector 鼠标，支持个性化方向灵敏度校准
items.title_en: Corsair Launches SABRE v3 PRO PureVector Mice With Directional Sensitivity Calibration
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，CORSAIR（海盗船）美国当地时间今日宣布推出 SABRE v3 PRO PureVector 鼠标，可选 ULTRALIGHT / MG / CF 三个版本、对称 / 右手 2 种模具。 该系列产品 在硬件上搭载 Nordic nRF54 系列 MCU、42K MARKSMAN X 光学传感器 、100M 光学开关与滚轮编码器，在 USB-C 和 2.4GHz 下均支持 8kHz 轮询率。 其支持海盗船与 AimLabs 合作开发的专利独家校准技术 PureVector。该技术分析用户在各个方向上的自然移动方式，并 根据个人的方向性瞄准偏差校准鼠标灵敏度 。其可将瞄准速度提升最多 81ms (33%)，并将方向性偏差平均降低 18%。 海盗船 SABRE v3 PRO PureVector 系列鼠标规格区分如下： 外壳材质 电池容量 对称款质量 右手款质量 蓝牙连接 定价 ULTRALIGHT ABS 塑料 小 37g 41g 无 179.99 美元 MG 镁合金 大 49g 55g 有 199.99 美元 CF 碳纤维 大 48g 54g 有 229.99 美元
items.summary_en: Corsair announced the SABRE v3 PRO PureVector gaming mice in ULTRIGHT, MG and CF versions, with Nordic nRF54 MCUs, a 42K Marksman X sensor and 8kHz polling over USB-C and 2.4GHz. The headline feature is PureVector, a patented calibration tech developed with AimLabs that tunes sensitivity to a user's directional aiming bias, claimed to improve aim speed by up to 81ms (33%) and cut directional deviation by 18%. Pricing runs from $179.99 to $229.99.
items.why_zh: 外设厂商开始把“个体化校准算法”作为核心卖点，显示 AI 与数据分析正渗透到游戏硬件。
items.why_en: Peripheral makers are making personalized calibration algorithms the core selling point, showing data-driven tuning spreading into gaming hardware.

items.title_zh: 法律与合规 AI 市场预计 2030 年达 1510 亿美元
items.title_en: Legal and Compliance Artificial Intelligence (AI) Market is Projected to Reach $151 Billion by 2030
items.summary_zh: 据《国家法律评论》（The National Law Review）报道，法律与合规领域的人工智能市场预计到 2030 年将增长至 1510 亿美元规模。这一预测反映出律所、企业法务与合规部门对自动化审查、文档处理与风险监测类 AI 工具的需求持续上升。报道未在摘要中详述统计口径与增长驱动细项，但这一量级意味着该细分市场将成为 AI 商业化的重要赛道。
items.summary_en: Legal and Compliance Artificial Intelligence (AI) Market is Projected to Reach $151 Billion by 2030 The National Law Review
items.why_zh: 法律合规是高价值、强监管的专业场景，其 AI 市场规模预测显示垂直行业应用正成为 AI 变现主力。
items.why_en: Legal and compliance is a high-value, heavily regulated niche, and its projected market size shows vertical AI applications becoming a major revenue driver.

items.title_zh: Spotify 一年内从推荐中移除 5000 万首 AI 垃圾与 spam 歌曲
items.title_en: Spotify pulled 50 million AI slop and spam tracks from its recommendations
items.summary_zh: Spotify 宣布，过去一年已从用户推荐中移除超过 5000 万首被视为“AI 垃圾内容（slop）”或 spam 的歌曲。公司同时调整了推荐系统，以更多地突出由人类艺术家创作的音乐，并表示其编辑团队遵循同样标准，不会把被判定为 slop 或 spam 的内容纳入编排。Spotify 称改动后听众对推荐中出现此类内容的投诉明显减少，但公司尚未要求对所有 AI 生成音乐强制标注。
items.summary_en: Spotify says it has removed more than 50 million songs considered AI-generated slop or spam from user recommendations over the past year. That's according to an announcement on Tuesday that says Spotify has also made changes to its recommendation system to highlight more music made by human artists. "Our editors hold the same standard and don't program content identified as slop or spam," Spotify says. "Since we made these changes, we've seen a marked decrease in listener concerns about this content showing up in recommendations." Though Spotify has stopped short of mandating labels on all AI…
items.why_zh: 流媒体平台首次大规模公开清理 AI 生成内容，将影响 AI 音乐的生存空间与平台内容治理规则。
items.why_en: A major streaming platform publicly purging AI-generated content at scale will shape the economics of AI music and set content-governance norms.

items.title_zh: 京东暂停双 11 期间外部安全测试及漏洞收录，未经授权测试将按违规处理
items.title_en: JD.com suspends external security testing and vulnerability submissions during Double 11
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，京东安全应急响应中心（JSRC）发布公告称，为降低外部安全测试对业务运行的影响，保障系统安全稳定，决定阶段性暂停外部授权安全测试及漏洞收录。 此次暂停时间为 2026 年 10 月 18 日 0 时至 11 月 18 日 10 时，覆盖京东所有产品、业务系统及相关资产。 京东将暂停原因指向近期多起白帽子使用 AI 工具测试时违规的情况，称相关行为已对生产环境稳定性造成干扰，而双 11 期间访问量、交易链路与后台作业均处于高峰，外部测试可能叠加的波动风险难以承受。 JSRC 表示，近期发现多起白帽子使用 AI 工具开展漏洞测试时出现违规行为，相关行为对京东生产环境稳定性造成干扰。双 11 期间，京东业务访问量、营销活动、交易链路及后台作业均处于高峰，因此决定暂停外部测试，以降低相关风险。 此次暂停并非仅针对使用 AI 工具开展的测试，而是覆盖京东全部产品、业务系统及相关资产的外部授权安全测试。IT之家注意到，暂停期间，JSRC 也将暂停收录相关漏洞报告。 JSRC 明确表示，暂停期间的任何未经授权测试行为均将被认定为违规测试。对于违反公告要求的行为，京东将根据实际影响采取相应措施，包括限制或封禁账号。如果相关行为造成系统异常、服务波动或其他不良后果，京东保留依法追究责任的权利。 公告还提示，未经授权对京东业务系统开展测试，可能涉及《中华人民共和国网络…
items.summary_en: JD.com's security response center said it will suspend externally authorized security testing and vulnerability submissions from Oct. 18 to Nov. 18, 2026, covering all products and business systems during the Double 11 peak. It cited recent violations by white hats using AI tools that disrupted production stability, plus peak traffic and transaction volumes. Unauthorized testing during the pause will be treated as a violation, with account restrictions or bans possible.
items.why_zh: 在 AI 降低漏洞挖掘门槛的背景下，电商平台选择在流量峰值期收紧外部测试边界，凸显业务稳定性与安全众测之间的张力。
items.why_en: As AI lowers the barrier to vulnerability discovery, the e-commerce giant is tightening external testing during peak traffic, highlighting the tension between stability and crowdsourced security.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 据称正与 Nscale 洽谈第二笔数十亿美元级交易
items.title_en: Anthropic in talks with neocloud Nscale over second multibillion-dollar deal, source tells CNBC
items.summary_zh: 据 CNBC 援引知情人士消息，Anthropic 正与新型云服务商 Nscale 洽谈第二笔数十亿美元级交易。报道未披露交易金额、算力规模、时间表及具体条款。若交易达成，将进一步扩大 Anthropic 的算力供应，也显示头部 AI 公司正持续通过 neocloud 锁定训练与推理基础设施。
items.summary_en: Anthropic in talks with neocloud Nscale over second multibillion-dollar deal, source tells CNBC CNBC
items.why_zh: 继首笔大单后再度加码 neocloud，反映 Anthropic 在算力军备竞赛中寻求多元化供应并减少对传统云巨头的依赖。
items.why_en: A second major neocloud deal would show Anthropic diversifying compute supply and reducing reliance on traditional cloud giants amid the AI arms race.

items.title_zh: 美国要求政府部门禁购DeepSeek等中国AI产品，商务部回应

items.summary_en: The US has directed government agencies not to purchase DeepSeek and other Chinese AI products, prompting a response from China's Ministry of Commerce. The move targets public-sector procurement and adds to ongoing US-China tech tensions.
items.why_zh: 政府采购禁令把中美 AI 竞争延伸到公共部门采购层面，可能影响中国 AI 企业的海外拓展。
items.why_en: A procurement ban extends US-China AI rivalry into public-sector purchasing and could affect Chinese AI firms' overseas expansion.

items.why_en: Flash-tier models directly affect inference cost and response speed, making comparisons useful for developers balancing performance and price.

items.summary_zh: 据 Yahoo Finance 报道，DeepSeek 已将名为 DeepInfer 的软件开源，目标是降低 AI 模型部署成本。报道摘要未披露其具体优化手段、支持的硬件平台或性能数据。若该工具能切实降低推理与部署门槛，将帮助开发者和企业以更低成本运行大模型，并延续 DeepSeek 以开源推动生态的策略。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer software to curb AI deployment costs Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 部署成本是生成式 AI 规模化的关键瓶颈，开源推理与部署工具可能加速大模型在更多企业落地。
items.why_en: Deployment cost is a key bottleneck for scaling generative AI, and open-source inference and deployment tools could accelerate enterprise adoption.

items.summary_en: Anthropic Will Be The Last AI IPO Of 2026, As Industry Collapses Yahoo Finance

items.why_en: If the IPO window narrows for leading AI companies, it could affect industry-wide fundraising, valuation benchmarks and startup exit expectations.

items.why_en: Litigation involving OpenAI's CEO draws attention to him and the company's governance, though dismissal does not amount to a final ruling on the underlying factual disputes.

items.title_zh: 2027 款极狐阿尔法 S5/T5 双车 10 月 23 日上市：驾趣、续航、智驾再升级
items.title_en: 2027 Arcfox Alpha S5 and T5 to launch on October 23
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，2027 款极狐阿尔法 S5 与阿尔法 T5 官宣将于 10 月 23 日正式上市，号称“驾趣升级、续航升级、智驾再突破”。 其中，2027 款极狐阿尔法 S5 继续提供纯电与增程双动力，T5 则把升级重心放在后驱布局、800V 平台和车顶激光雷达的加入上。 S5 变化有限，核心在于车顶激光雷达与新增的前备箱。外观延续“风塑美学”的溜背轿跑轮廓，无边框车门、隐藏式门把手、贯穿尾灯和可升降后扰流板均被保留。 T5 的改动更偏向结构性的动力布局调整。驱动形式从前置前驱改为后驱，换装最大功率 227 千瓦（309 马力）、峰值扭矩 334 牛 · 米的后置电机，机舱因此腾出空间，新增容积约 185 升的电动前备箱。全域 800V 高压平台与宁德时代电池全系标配，神行 5C 超充的补能节奏大致为 15 分钟补充 500 公里续航。纯电版 CLTC 续航分为 601 公里和 680 公里两个版本。 另外，T5 的车顶激光雷达与智驾芯片方案目前存在不同说法：工信部申报信息及多个来源指向 192 线激光雷达配合地平线 J6M 方案，另有实车体验指向高通骁龙 8775 舱驾一体式芯片、算力标注为 192TOPS，官方尚未在预热阶段明确最终的量产配置。 座舱层面的调整属于细节优化。T5 换装三辐式方向盘，中央岛台重新布局，保留悬浮中控屏与 HUD 抬头显示，门板等位…
items.summary_en: The 2027 Arcfox Alpha S5 and Alpha T5 will launch on October 23, with upgrades in driving fun, range and smart driving. The S5 keeps pure-electric and range-extender powertrains and adds a roof lidar and front trunk, while the T5 switches to rear-wheel drive with a 227 kW/334 Nm rear motor and an approximately 185-liter electric front trunk. The T5 offers an 800V platform and CATL batteries across the lineup, with 5C fast charging adding about 500 km in 15 minutes and CLTC range of 601 km or 680 km; final lidar and smart-driving chip details are not yet confirmed.
items.why_zh: 双车把 800V、后驱和激光雷达智驾下放到更主流产品，显示极狐正以配置升级应对激烈的纯电市场竞争。
items.why_en: Bringing 800V, rear-wheel drive and lidar-based smart driving to more mainstream models shows Arcfox is using feature upgrades to compete in a crowded EV market.

items.title_zh: 丰田计划到 2030 年完成 SDV 普及，固态电池 2027~2028 年进入市场
items.title_en: Toyota Targets Full SDV Rollout by 2030; Solid-State Batteries to Launch in 2027-2028
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，据《日经亚洲》上周报道，丰田 (Toyota) 在本月举行的欧洲投资者简报会上表示， 目标到 2030 年实现 50 款车型的全面 SDV（软件定义汽车）化 。 丰田希望将旗下 Woven 的 Arene 软件开发平台推广到自家车辆以外的领域 ：其计划在 2035 年前向其它汽车制造商提供技术授权，将 Arene 扩展至机器人、住宅、电线杆等 IoT 设备。 该企业的目标是到 2030 财年实现 3 万亿日元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,267.47 亿元人民币） 的非新车销售年营业利润，较目前水平增长约 40%。而在这一过程中，SDV 技术的推广将做出贡献。 丰田还 计划对外销售适用于混动与燃油车辆的发动机 ，这部分业务到 2032 年可实现 2,500 亿日元 （现汇率约合 105.62 亿元人民币） 收入；其 固态电池预计将于 2027~2028 年进入市场 ，率先应用于商用车和无人机。 《日经亚洲》还在另一篇报道中提到，丰田计划通过与一汽的合资企业于 2028 年在中国量产新一代卡罗拉。这一车型基于 2025 年公布的 概念车 ，采用多动力架构兼容平台，提供纯电、混动、燃油等版本。 参考 https://asia.nikkei.com/business/automobiles/toyota-to-turn-all-50-models-in…
items.summary_en: Toyota said at a European investor briefing that it aims to make all 50 models software-defined vehicles (SDVs) by 2030, while promoting its Woven Arene software platform. It plans to license Arene to other automakers by 2035 and extend it to robots, homes and other IoT devices. Toyota also targets ¥3 trillion in annual non-new-car operating profit by fiscal 2030, plans to sell engines for hybrid and combustion vehicles, and expects solid-state batteries to reach the market in 2027-2028, starting with commercial vehicles and drones.
items.why_zh: 丰田把 SDV、平台授权和固态电池商业化绑定为增长路径，显示传统车企正加速向软件与能源技术转型。
items.why_en: By tying SDVs, platform licensing and solid-state battery commercialization to growth, Toyota shows traditional automakers are accelerating their shift toward software and energy technologies.

items.title_zh: 刚把性价比卷上来，DeepSeek 就被怀疑蒸馏了GPT
items.title_en: DeepSeek Faces Distillation Scrutiny After Cost-Effectiveness Gains Attention
items.summary_zh: 刚把性价比卷上来，DeepSeek 就被怀疑蒸馏了GPT 潮起网
items.summary_en: Chaoxi reports that DeepSeek, recently praised for its cost-effectiveness, is now being suspected of distilling GPT to obtain model capabilities. The controversy raises questions about model provenance, technical routes and competitive ethics. The summary does not include specific evidence or full responses from the parties involved.
items.why_zh: 蒸馏争议触及模型能力来源与技术独立性，是评估 AI 公司竞争力与合规风险的重要议题。
items.why_en: Distillation allegations touch on model provenance and technical independence, key issues for assessing AI companies' competitiveness and compliance risks.

items.title_zh: 美国多个政府部门禁用Deepseek，包括第三方集成服务

items.summary_zh: 美国多个政府部门禁用Deepseek，包括第三方集成服务 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Sohu reports that multiple U.S. government departments have banned DeepSeek, with the prohibition also covering use through third-party integration services. The summary does not list specific departments, effective dates or the full policy text. The move signals tighter security scrutiny of Chinese AI services in government settings.
items.why_zh: 政府机构禁用范围扩大到第三方集成，可能影响 DeepSeek 的海外企业客户与合规部署路径。
items.why_en: Extending the ban to third-party integrations could affect DeepSeek's overseas enterprise customers and compliance deployment paths.

items.title_zh: Eunice Chiweshe Goldstein 发布 LikenKey™：面向生成式 AI 的身份与肖像授权技术
items.title_en: Eunice Chiweshe Goldstein Announces LikenKey™, a Patent-Pending AI Identity and Likeness Authorization Technology Designed to Protect Human Rights in the Generative AI Era
items.summary_zh: Eunice Chiweshe Goldstein 宣布推出 LikenKey™，这是一项正在申请专利的 AI 身份与肖像授权技术，目标是保护生成式 AI 时代的人权。该技术聚焦个人身份和肖像在 AI 系统中的授权使用，强调对个人形象与身份的控制。报道以发布信息为主，未在摘要中披露具体技术实现、合作方或商业化时间表。
items.summary_en: Eunice Chiweshe Goldstein Announces LikenKey™, a Patent-Pending AI Identity and Likeness Authorization Technology Designed to Protect Human Rights in the Generative AI Era Morningstar
items.why_zh: 随着生成式 AI 滥用肖像与身份的风险上升，授权与追溯机制成为保护个人权利的关键基础设施。
items.why_en: As generative AI raises risks of identity and likeness misuse, authorization and traceability mechanisms are becoming key infrastructure for protecting individual rights.

items.title_zh: 智谱四创始人据报曾与被英国军情五处示警的中国机构开发AI工具
items.title_en: Report: Four Zhipu Founders Previously Developed AI Tools With Chinese Institution Flagged by UK MI5
items.summary_zh: 智谱四创始人据报曾与被英国军情五处示警的中国机构开发AI工具 RFI
items.summary_en: RFI reports that four founders of Zhipu allegedly previously developed AI tools with a Chinese institution that UK MI5 has warned about. The report links this past cooperation to security concerns, but the summary does not disclose the institution's name, timing or project details. The claim may fuel discussion about AI talent backgrounds, cross-border technology cooperation and national security reviews.
items.why_zh: AI 创始团队的跨境合作背景正被纳入国家安全审查视野，可能影响中国 AI 公司的国际业务与人才流动。
items.why_en: The cross-border collaboration background of AI founders is increasingly subject to national security scrutiny, potentially affecting Chinese AI firms' global business and talent flows.

items.title_zh: 美国联邦机构禁用 DeepSeek 后，中国回应称其“泛化国家安全”
items.title_en: China defends DeepSeek after U.S. bans its AI in federal agencies, calling it 'overstretching' national security
items.summary_zh: 据 Fortune 报道，在美国联邦机构禁用 DeepSeek 后，中国方面为这家 AI 公司作出辩护，批评美方将国家安全概念“泛化”或“过度延伸”。报道聚焦围绕 DeepSeek 的中美监管争议，但摘要未列出具体禁令范围或双方完整声明。此事凸显 AI 模型正成为国家安全与科技竞争的交汇点。
items.summary_en: China defends DeepSeek after U.S. bans its AI in federal agencies, calling it 'overstretching' national security Fortune
items.why_zh: DeepSeek 争议显示 AI 模型已被纳入地缘政治与国家安全框架，企业面临更高的跨境合规不确定性。
items.why_en: The DeepSeek dispute shows AI models are being drawn into geopolitics and national security frameworks, raising cross-border compliance uncertainty for companies.

items.title_zh: 凤凰航运(000520.SZ)：在编制2025年年度报告中未使用DeepSeek、豆包等生成式人工智能工具
items.title_en: Phoenix Shipping Says It Did Not Use DeepSeek, Doubao or Other Generative AI Tools in 2025 Annual Report
items.summary_zh: 凤凰航运(000520.SZ)：在编制2025年年度报告中未使用DeepSeek、豆包等生成式人工智能工具 证券之星
items.summary_en: Phoenix Shipping (000520.SZ) said it did not use generative AI tools such as DeepSeek or Doubao in preparing its 2025 annual report. The statement clarifies the company's disclosure process amid growing market attention to generative AI use. The summary does not say whether the company uses such tools in other business areas.
items.why_zh: 上市公司主动说明年报编制是否使用生成式 AI，反映信息披露合规与 AI 使用边界正受到更严格审视。
items.why_en: A listed company clarifying whether it used generative AI in annual report preparation reflects stricter scrutiny of disclosure compliance and AI usage boundaries.

items.title_zh: 美国下令联邦机构移除DeepSeek AI产品
items.title_en: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
items.summary_zh: 美国政府以国家安全为由，要求联邦文职机构从系统中移除DeepSeek产品，以及使用其技术构建的第三方服务。报道未披露命令的具体执行时限、涉及机构范围和技术细节。此举将限制DeepSeek在美国政府体系中的使用，并可能影响其相关第三方服务商。这一命令延续了美国对中国AI技术进入政府与关键基础设施的审查趋势，也可能促使使用相关模型的承包商调整供应链。对DeepSeek而言，美国联邦市场进一步关闭；对第三方开发者而言，需排查其服务是否依赖DeepSeek技术。
items.summary_en: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.
items.why_zh: 这是美国政府对中国AI工具实施更严格限制的最新动作，直接影响DeepSeek在美政府及承包商体系中的可用性。
items.why_en: It marks another tightening of US restrictions on Chinese AI tools, directly affecting DeepSeek’s use across federal agencies and contractors.

items.title_zh: Adobe Lightroom移动端可用生成式AI一键睁眼
items.title_en: Adobe Lightroom mobile can now open closed eyes in photos with a simple tap
items.summary_zh: Adobe宣布，iOS、iPadOS和Android版Lightroom移动端新增生成式AI“睁眼”功能，用户只需轻点即可修复照片中闭眼的人物。当应用检测到单人或多人在照片中闭眼时，会在图像上显示“Open Eyes”快捷操作图标，方便直接使用。类似能力此前已在Photoshop Elements中存在近十年，如今被引入移动端Lightroom。该功能有望帮助用户挽救原本质量不错但因闭眼而废弃的照片。
items.summary_en: Adobe announced yesterday that the mobile version of Lightroom , available for iOS, iPadOS, and Android, can now open closed eyes in photos using generative AI with just a single tap. When the app detects a person, or a group of people, have their eyes closed in a photo it will automatically present users with a new Open Eyes Quick Action that appears as an icon over the image providing easy access to the new feature. Being able to easily save an otherwise great photo by opening a subject's eyes has been a feature in Adobe's Photoshop Elements for nearly a decade, but as DPReview points out ,…
items.why_zh: 生成式AI正被嵌入日常修图工具，降低人像修复门槛，也引发对照片真实性的持续讨论。
items.why_en: Generative AI is moving into everyday photo editing, making portrait fixes easier while raising ongoing questions about image authenticity.

items.title_zh: 美国政府机构禁用DeepSeek AI工具
items.title_en: US bans use of China’s DeepSeek AI tools by government agencies
items.summary_zh: 据《卫报》报道，美国已禁止政府机构使用中国AI公司DeepSeek的工具。此前有报道称，美方以国家安全为由要求联邦文职机构移除DeepSeek产品及相关第三方服务。该禁令将限制DeepSeek在美国政府体系中的使用，并可能波及依赖其技术的承包商和服务商。具体执行范围与时间表尚待进一步明确。这反映出华盛顿对AI供应链安全和数据风险的担忧持续上升。
items.summary_en: US bans use of China’s DeepSeek AI tools by government agencies The Guardian
items.why_zh: 禁令把对中国AI模型的审查从联邦机构扩展到政府供应链，影响DeepSeek的海外合规与市场空间。
items.why_en: The ban extends scrutiny of Chinese AI models into the government supply chain, affecting DeepSeek’s overseas compliance and market access.

items.title_zh: 前OpenAI高管为国防初创公司融资，估值达15亿美元
items.title_en: Former top OpenAI employees raises capital for defense startup valued at $1.5B
items.summary_zh: 据CNBC报道，多名前OpenAI高层员工正在为一家国防科技初创公司筹集资金，该公司估值约为15亿美元。报道未披露本轮融资额、投资方以及公司具体业务细节。AI人才与资本流向国防领域，正成为硅谷新的创业与投资热点。该交易也凸显大型AI公司前员工在敏感技术领域的影响力和争议性。
items.summary_en: Former top OpenAI employees raises capital for defense startup valued at $1.5B CNBC
items.why_zh: 它显示顶级AI人才正把生成式AI能力带入国防科技，并引发资本与伦理层面的关注。
items.why_en: It shows top AI talent moving into defense tech, drawing both investment interest and ethical scrutiny.

items.title_zh: 前OpenAI高管低调打造15亿美元初创公司，押注AI振兴美国制造业
items.title_en: Former OpenAI exec has quietly built $1.5 billion startup, betting AI can revive U.S. manufacturing
items.summary_zh: 据CNBC报道，一位前OpenAI高管已悄然打造出一家估值约15亿美元的初创公司，核心押注是用人工智能振兴美国制造业。报道未披露公司名称、融资规模和具体产品路径。该案例反映出AI创业正从模型层走向制造业等实体经济场景。若技术落地顺利，可能为美国制造业的自动化与效率提升提供新工具。
items.summary_en: Former OpenAI exec has quietly built $1.5 billion startup, betting AI can revive U.S. manufacturing CNBC
items.why_zh: 若AI真能提升制造效率，这将触及美国制造业回流与产业竞争力的核心议题。
items.why_en: If AI can improve manufacturing efficiency, it could matter for US industrial competitiveness and reshoring efforts.

items.title_en: Not Anthropic. Not OpenAI. This Is the Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock I'd Buy Before the Next Mega-IPO.

items.why_zh: 它反映资本市场正围绕下一批AI IPO寻找“替代标的”，也提醒读者区分投资观点与事实报道。
items.why_en: It reflects investor appetite for AI exposure ahead of potential mega-IPOs and the need to separate opinion from reporting.

items.title_zh: OpenAI赶在Anthropic上市前冲刺300亿美元融资
items.title_en: OpenAI Is Racing to Raise $30 Billion Before Anthropic Goes Public
items.summary_zh: 据雅虎财经报道，OpenAI正在赶在Anthropic上市之前筹集300亿美元资金。报道未披露本轮融资的估值、投资方名单和具体时间表。若顺利完成，这将成为AI领域规模最大的融资之一，进一步加剧头部模型公司的资本竞赛。Anthropic的IPO预期也在升温，使两家公司的竞争从模型能力延伸到资本市场。
items.summary_en: OpenAI Is Racing to Raise $30 Billion Before Anthropic Goes Public Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 融资节奏与IPO时间点的竞争，显示AI头部公司正用资本构筑算力和人才壁垒。
items.why_en: The fundraising and IPO timing race shows leading AI firms are using capital to build compute and talent moats.

items.title_zh: “豆包对低认知人群有权威性”登上热搜，AI回答的权威性从何而来？
items.title_en: Doubao’s authority among low-literacy users sparks debate on AI answer credibility
items.summary_zh: “豆包对低认知人群有权威性”登上热搜，AI回答的权威性从何而来？ 新浪网
items.summary_en: A Chinese hot-search topic claiming Doubao has authority among low-literacy users has sparked debate over why AI answers are trusted. A Sina article asks where that authority comes from—model tone, data sources or platform endorsement—and links it to hallucination, information literacy and platform responsibility.
items.why_zh: 当AI助手被部分用户当作“权威答案”，平台如何管理可信度与幻觉风险将直接影响公共信息质量。
items.why_en: As some users treat AI assistants as authoritative, how platforms manage credibility and hallucination risk will directly affect public information quality.
